title: Require Domain Model Source Topology
forbids: domain or module model roots outside the positive atom, policy, and shared-rule owner topology
why: The model source kind owns vocabulary and neutral shared domain logic at the nearest semantic domain or module level. Keeping this topology separate prevents router structure from mixing with atoms, policy, or rules and prevents shared logic from becoming another nested registry or helper cabinet.
remediate: Keep schema-bearing reusable vocabulary in atoms, semantic decisions in policy, and flat semantically named shared algorithms in rules. Hoist only members shared by multiple modules, forbid rule barrels, and move every other child to its actual owner or delete it.
message: Domain model roots must match the positive domain-model blueprint spine.
